consent.title: Privacy choices
consent.body: We use necessary cookies to run this site, and optional analytics to understand what helps visitors. Analytics stays off until you allow it. Details in our privacy policy.
consent.necessaryDesc: Required for the site and the enquiry form to work. Always on.
consent.analyticsDesc: Privacy-respecting measurement of pages and enquiry events.

enquiry.title: Tell us about your visit.
enquiry.intro: Choose the path that fits. Every enquiry receives a first response within 48 hours; Event and MICE RFPs within one business day.
enquiry.draftRestored: We restored your draft from this device.
enquiry.attachmentsHint: Up to 100 MB in total (PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, JPG, PNG, MP4). Larger files: we will send a secure upload link.
enquiry.consentLabel: I agree to the processing of this enquiry as described in the privacy policy.
enquiry.errorBody: Your details are still on this page. Please try again, or reach us on WhatsApp or by email and we will pick it up from there.
enquiry.emailInvalid: Please enter a valid e-mail address.
enquiry.consentRequired: Please confirm the privacy consent to send your enquiry.
enquiry.fileTooLarge: This file exceeds the size limit.
enquiry.fileTypeBlocked: This file type is not accepted.
enquiry.totalTooLarge: Attachments exceed the total size limit.

notFound.title: This page has moved on.
notFound.body: The address you followed does not exist. The compass below points to the busiest paths.

error.title: Something went wrong on our side.
error.body: The page failed to load. Please try again; if it persists, reach us by e-mail or WhatsApp.
